title: Stress IQ test during Air Force recruitment screening

tellings.quote: And so you take the same test, but I put on this oxygen mask that sealed my face with no air coming to it.

plain: Jake Barber, a former helicopter pilot who says he once carried a UFO with his aircraft, told the podcast host Jesse Michels about being screened for the Air Force around 1994 near UCLA, a university in Los Angeles. He says he took an intelligence test once normally and then again wearing an oxygen mask sealed to his face with no air coming in. He tells it to show the unusual testing he says marked him for special work.
